skills.description: Portable, agent-agnostic skill for writing calendar events on behalf of a user using ONLY a calendar access token (no passwords, no SDK). It verifies the token, parses natural-language descriptions into a normalized event, validates, and executes create / update / batch / soft-delete / recover against a configurable RESTful calendar backend. Returns a unified JSON response with event id and safe error info. Covers conflict detection, idempotency, offline queue/replay, audit, timeouts, retry, encryption and health checks. Use whenever a user wants to add/change/remove a schedule in their own calendar and supplies (or can supply) a token. Triggers: "把会议加进日历", "帮我更新明天的日程", "同步到我的日历", "删除/恢复某个日程", "批量导入日程", any agent task that writes user calendar events via a token.
